title: Stadium: AWS DevOps Engineer
description:
Headquarters: India

We are looking for an experienced AWS DevOps Engineer who enjoys solving complex, real-world infrastructure problems at scale.

At Stadium, we’re building products that bring delight and connection to organizations worldwide. From rewards and recognition to personalized gifting and brand experiences, our platform combines creativity, data, and technology to make every interaction meaningful. Our systems handle extreme and unpredictable traffic spikes — from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of requests per minute — and this role plays a critical part in keeping them fast, reliable, and secure.

In this role, you will take end-to-end ownership of cloud infrastructure: from architecture and automation to deployment, monitoring, security, performance, scalability, and cost optimization. You will work closely with software engineers to define infrastructure standards and deployment practices, and you’ll be expected to reason through ambiguous problems, challenge assumptions, and design practical, production-ready solutions.

Your Role

You will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and operating secure, scalable, and highly available AWS infrastructure.
  • Architecting systems that can handle sudden and massive traffic surges.
  • Owning architectural decisions, trade-offs, and outcomes in production environments.
  • Ensuring fault tolerance, high availability, and disaster recovery.
  • Building and managing infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Automating provisioning, scaling, recovery, and operational workflows.
  • Designing and maintaining robust CI/CD pipelines for safe, repeatable, zero-downtime deployments.
  • Partnering with engineering teams to evolve infrastructure and deployment standards.
  • Implementing monitoring, alerting, and observability for proactive issue detection.
  • Leading incident response, root cause analysis, and long-term system improvements.
  • Owning cloud security posture and enforcing best practices.
  • Monitoring and optimizing cloud costs while maintaining performance and scalability.

What You'll Bring to the Table

Primary Requirements:

  • 4–7 years of hands-on experience with AWS in production environments.
  • Proven experience operating and improving high-traffic, high-availability systems.
  • Strong understanding of cloud networking, security, and system design.
  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code using Terraform.
  • Experience designing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines.
  • Strong Linux system administration skills.
  • Proficiency in scripting and at least one programming language.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to clearly explain past decisions, trade-offs, failures, and learnings.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous environments without rigid SOPs.
  • Strong ownership mindset and problem-solving skills.

Preferred Requirements:

  • AWS certifications.
  • Experience in fast-growing or high-scale environments.
  • Experience supporting modern web applications.
  • Competitive salary based on skill set.
  • Fully remote role - work with talented teammates across the globe.
  • Flexible working hours and autonomy over your schedule.
  • 5-day work week for better work-life balance.
  • Team retreats and offsites to connect and recharge.
  • Meal vouchers and employee benefits(health insurance) support.
  • Internal learning tracks to grow into other areas of development.
  • Plenty of company swag and additional perks.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/stadium-aws-devops-engineer

title: Confluent: Senior Product Manager, Cluster Linking
description:
Headquarters: Remote, Ontario, Canada

We’re not just building better tech. We’re rewriting how data moves and what the world can do with it. With Confluent, data doesn’t sit still. Our platform puts information in motion, streaming in near real-time so companies can react faster, build smarter, and deliver experiences as dynamic as the world around them.

It takes a certain kind of person to join this team. Those who ask hard questions, give honest feedback, and show up for each other. No egos, no solo acts. Just smart, curious humans pushing toward something bigger, together.

One Confluent. One Team. One Data Streaming Platform.

About the Role:

Cluster Linking is how Kafka clusters are replicated, and it sits at the very core of Confluent. When a global bank architects zero-data-loss disaster recovery, when an enterprise migrates petabytes off open-source Kafka, or when a multinational replicates event streams across three continents, they're running on Cluster Linking.

This role will define the future of Cluster Linking: how we deliver seamless disaster recovery for Kafka workloads, how we build self-service migration paths into Confluent Cloud, and how we enable cross-organization data sharing to power real-time, operational data exchanges.

Cluster Linking is one of Confluent's fastest-growing platform products and you'll own that growth. Our largest customers depend on it, and because it cuts across Kafka, cloud infrastructure, networking, and security, your work will have visibility and influence across the company.

What You Will Do:

  • Launch and drive adoption for our one-click DR initiative. Take disaster recovery from a manually configured capability to a seamless, productized experience that customers can adopt with confidence.

  • Define the future of real-time stream sharing across organizations, including its security model, networking, access controls, and how it scales across organizations and use cases.

  • Power capabilities that let customers migrate to Confluent in a few clicks or API calls. Define the art of the possible and make the migration path a reason to choose Confluent.

  • Segment and re-package Cluster Linking. The product serves Disaster Recovery, migrations, data sharing, and cross-cloud replication, each with different customer needs and pricing dynamics. Define how we package, price, and position each so the offering works for customers and drives growth.

  • Partner closely with your engineering manager counterpart as a strategic partner. Use that partnership to understand tradeoffs, make decisions fast, and keep the product moving forward.

  • Work directly with customers. You'll be pulled in many directions, customers will ask a lot of you. Your job is to steer them toward the right architectures and models, get them excited about what's coming, listen to what they need next, and balance the present opportunity with where the product is headed.

  • Drive results. Run campaigns with sellers and solutions engineers, lead webinars, assemble teams of subject matter experts, and do what it takes to move your priorities forward.

  • Influence and energize the people around you. Confluent moves fast and people are ready to help. Harness that, get teams excited, rally cross-functional support, and turn organizational momentum into product momentum.

What You Will Bring:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in infrastructure, data platforms, or cloud products. You've shipped technical products and driven measurable outcomes.

  • Genuine interest in distributed systems and cloud infrastructure. Kafka is not simple. You don't need prior Kafka expertise, but you need to be energized by technical depth, not put off by it.

  • A results-driven mindset. You don't wait for things to happen, you make them happen. You get on calls with sellers, you pull in the right people, and you keep pushing until the work is done.

  • Proven ability to influence. You get people excited and aligned, across engineering, field, sales, finance, and leadership, often without formal authority.

  • Strong ownership mentality. You take responsibility from day one. You drive ambiguous problems to clarity, remove blockers, and treat the product like your own business.

  • Business thinking beyond the backlog. You think about segmentation, packaging, pricing, and market impact, not just features. You understand that how a product is offered matters as much as what it does.

  • Clear communication. You can make technical topics understandable for executive audiences, write sharp product docs, and present confidently to customers and leadership.

  • LLM or GenAI knowledge is a bonus, but not required

Ready to build what's next? Let’s get in motion.

Come As You Are

Belonging isn’t a perk here. It’s the baseline. We work across time zones and backgrounds, knowing the best ideas come from different perspectives. And we make space for everyone to lead, grow, and challenge what’s possible.

We’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. Employment decisions are based on job-related criteria, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other classification protected by law.

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/confluent-senior-product-manager-cluster-linking

title: Supportyourapp: (Native Finnish) Customer Support Consultant (Future Openings, remotely)
description:
